subject: PrivInfra IPAM + cross-subnet routing — GitOps alignment
messages:
From: Alex Martin <alex.martin@acmebio.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ops Automation <support@vendornet.io>
Date: Sat, 12 Dec 2026 08:14:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Private stack - IPAM & subnet plan (initial)

Vanessa —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Per our call, we did a quick run through of our on-prem topology and have two asks before we sign off the SOW:

1) IPAM integration — we run NetBox for inventory and want to avoid split-brain allocations between Redwoods' bootstrap modules and our NetBox instance. Can your Terraform modules either accept an external IPAM (NetBox plugin) or expose an idempotent allocation step we can call from our pre-provision pipeline?

2) Cross-subnet routing — our team wants a supported plan for routing between tenant subnets without going through the public internet or relying on a single L3 gateway. Specifically: VPC-like routing across two racks with EVPN overlay or static route program (we're open to options).

I attached a sketch of our current IP plan (priv-ipam-diagram-dec2026.pdf). Also copying VendorNet (support@vendornet.io) who will help with the BGP/eBPF appliance.

Next step: can your IaC owners and network folks review and propose concrete changes to the terraform/helm layout so we can keep everything GitOps-first?

—Alex
Senior Infra Eng, Acme BioTech

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Martin <alex.martin@acmebio.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ops Automation <support@vendornet.io>
Date: Mon, 14 Dec 2026 09:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Private stack - IPAM & subnet plan (initial)

Alex — thanks for the clear asks and the diagram. Looping in Kim, Karthik, and Marissa to get IaC + network-operational alignment.

Quick response up front:
- We can change the Terraform IPAM module to be netbox-backed (flag: ipam.backend = "netbox") so allocations are authoritative in NetBox. If NetBox is absent we fall back to the current stateful allocation.
- For cross-subnet routing, our recommended pattern for on-prem is: per-rack BGP speakers + leaf aggregation layer + EVPN VXLAN overlay (evpn module). We can provide helm charts to install the VXLAN agents and a TF module that wires BGP peering config to your BGP appliances.

Action items I want the infra owners to propose by EOD Wednesday (16 Dec):
- Concrete changes to the TF module inputs & outputs so Acme's NetBox is treated as the source-of-truth.
- Helm values to deploy the VXLAN agents and any required CNI tweaks.
- A short rollback plan if peering fails during cutover.

Attaching a short patch with suggested TF patches (tf-modules-ipam-v1.2.patch.txt) and example helm-values for Acme (helm-values-acme-profiles.yaml).

Vanessa Ortiz
Partner Solutions, Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Alex Martin <alex.martin@acmebio.com>
Cc: Ops Automation <support@vendornet.io>
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 10:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Private stack - IPAM & subnet plan (initial)

Vanessa / team / Alex —

Read the diagram and reviewed the patch. A few technical points and a proposed minimal change set:

1) IPAM plugin design (Terraform):
- Proposal: Add a provider wrapper module redwood_ipam that supports three modes: "managed" (current behaviour, allocations via state), "netbox" (NetBox REST-backed allocations), and "api" (customer API).
- Implementation note: netbox mode will require a NetBox access token stored in customer KMS; we'll add a secret id reference to the module variables but avoid pulling plaintext secrets into state (we'll pass a secret_ref and instruct users to set it in CI).

2) GitOps & drift detection:
- We will ship a periodic job (helm chart) that runs reconcile-ipam (read-only) comparing NetBox allocations with TF state and surfaces diffs to a PR in the customer's gitops repo via a webhook. This avoids unsafe automated rewrites of customer-owned allocations.

3) Cross-subnet routing plan:
- Option A (preferred): EVPN VXLAN with per-rack BGP speakers. Requires vendor appliance config pushed via vendornet API; vendornet already supports a provisioning endpoint (support@vendornet.io).
- Option B: Static route-programming using our route-controller for small deployments (less operational overhead but scales poorly).

4) Rollback plan: we will provide a canary cutover flow: create secondary VXLAN VNI for test traffic, validate reachability, then flip tenant route references (PR + apply). If failure, remove the new VNI and routes — no change to allocations.

Open questions for Alex:
- Is NetBox already in your CI KMS? If not, we'll need the secret_ref and an owner who can approve access.

I'll draft a concrete set of TF input/output changes and a Helm values example by EOD today.

—Karthik
Senior Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Alex Martin <alex.martin@acmebio.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ops Automation <support@vendornet.io>
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 13:36:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Private stack - IPAM & subnet plan (initial)

Karthik / team —

This looks good. Quick answers:
- NetBox token is stored in our internal Vault (HashiCorp) and we can provide a read-only token scoped to allocations; name the required secret_ref and we'll create it.
- We prefer Option A (EVPN) — scale and operational familiarity.

One ask on the GitOps reconcile job: rather than opening PRs in our repo, can the reconcile job generate a diagnostic report + Jira ticket with suggested diffs? Our security team restricts automated PRs from third-party bots. If you can trigger a ticket + include the suggested human curated patch that works better for us.

Thanks — Alex

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Martin <alex.martin@acmebio.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ops Automation <support@vendornet.io>
Date: Wed, 15 Dec 2026 15:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Private stack - IPAM & subnet plan (initial)

Alex — thanks for the quick answers and for the Vault note. We'll update the reconcile plan to create a Jira ticket (we'll include the diff and a human-verify checklist) instead of opening PRs.

Summary of next concrete deliverables (owners & ETA):
- Karthik: redwood_ipam module change set + variable docs (draft PR to our private infra repo) — 16 Dec EOD.
- Marissa: helm-values and reconcile-job helm chart adjustments (Jira integration) — 17 Dec 10:00 PT.
- Vanessa: cutover runbook and canary test plan (will attach to SOW) — 17 Dec EOD.

We will mark this thread as the authoritative alignment and follow up with a short call tomorrow to walk through the patch. Thanks everyone.

Kimberly Park
Director, Solutions Engineering, Redwood Inference
